title: AgenticRAGTracer: A Hop-Aware Benchmark for Diagnosing Multi-Step Retrieval Reasoning in Agentic RAG
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking multi-hop reasoning and retrieval in agentic RAG systems. While some test examples (such as those regarding the Wesleyan Church and Arminianism) involve theological or religious subject matter, these are used strictly as factual data points from Wikipedia to evaluate logical reasoning chains rather than to evaluate religion, faith, or ethics themselves. The inclusion of a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section for human annotation does not meet the criteria for being faith- or ethics-related per the instructions.
